name: Olectra Greentech Ltd
about: Olectra Greentech Limited was incorporated in 2000 . The Company is primarily engaged in the manufacturing of composite polymer insulators and electrical buses. Its registered office is in Hyderabad. [1] [2]
keyPoints: Business Segments [1] a) Mobility Division (86% in Q1 FY27 vs 84% in Q1 FY26): [2] [3] [4] The company is India’s largest pure-play electric bus manufacturer, with an estimated 20%+ market share, and was the first company to launch electric buses in India. It has 4,000+ vehicles on the road, covering 700 Mn+ green kilometres. The company offers 7-metre, 9-metre and 12-metre electric buses for intra-city and inter-city applications, along with electric coaches and tippers, with driving ranges of 200-350+ km. Its customer base includes TSRTC, KSRTC, GMR-Airport, Microsoft, Fresh Bus and MSRTC, among others. The company sold 1,280 EVs in FY26, up from 972 in FY25.
